description: 한국공항공사_실시간 항공기 운항정보 조회_GW [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국공항공사. 한국공항공사는 인천국제공항을 제외한 김포, 김해, 제주, 대구 등 전국 14개 공항을 통합 관리하고 운영하는 대한민국의 대표적인 공공기관입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국공항공사. Its tags are 보험사용 항공편 지연결항, 실시간 운항정보, 실시간 항공운항 현황정보, 한국공항공사, 보험사용 실시간 운항정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
